title: MoE-Lightning: High-Throughput MoE Inference on Memory-constrained GPUs
technique: CPU-GPU-I/O pipelined schedule (CGOPipe) with paged weights plus Hierarchical Roofline Model (HRM) to pick batch/micro-batch/offload policy for offline MoE batch inference

optimized_metrics.evidence: In this paper, we study how to achieve high-throughput MoE inference with limited GPU memory. We are focusing on off-line, batch-processing workloads such as model evaluation [29], synthetic data generation [14], data wrangling [33], ... where higher inference throughput translates into lower total completion time.
we search for the optimal policy P that minimizes per-layer latency T(M, H, W, P) for the pipeline schedule in §4.1, without violating the CPU and GPU memory constraints
CGOPipe, a pipeline scheduling strategy that efficiently schedules various I/O events and overlaps CPU and GPU computation with I/O events ... significantly enhancing throughput and I/O efficiency

headline_claim.text: MoE-Lightning can achieve up to 10.3× higher throughput than state-of-the-art offloading-enabled LLM inference systems for Mixtral 8x7B on a single T4 GPU (16GB).

metric_definitions.definition_quote: We measure the generation throughput for each workload, which is calculated as the number of tokens generated divided by total generation time (i.e., prefill time + decode time).
metric_definitions.notes: Generated (output) tokens over prefill+decode wall time; prompt tokens not counted.

metric_definitions.definition_quote: Batch size is the total number of tokens processed by one pass of the whole model.
metric_definitions.notes: Batch size is tokens per pass, split into micro-batches μ.

load_regime: Offline batch processing: large fixed request batches (thousands of requests), batch/micro-batch size searched by HRM; generation length sweep 32-256 on MTBench; no latency SLO
tradeoff_acknowledged: Paper states it targets offline batch workloads where higher throughput translates into lower total completion time; per-request latency is not optimized or reported.
workloads: MTBench, synthetic reasoning, summarization (HELM); with and without request padding
extractor_notes: Throughput-only offline paper; no latency metric, no accuracy evaluation (offloading is numerically lossless; no QUALITY constraint stated). Speed is at the throughput-maximizing batch policy, not a latency-sensitive load. Headline 10.3x is without padding; 3.5x with padding. Baselines include FlexGen, DeepSpeed-Zero.
